title: One operator for each binding
statement: A slot operator MUST be exactly one of gate, chain or fan-out.

title: One of three stages
statement: A maturity stage MUST be exactly one of alpha, beta or ga.

title: Common or local
statement: A registry trust MUST be exactly one of common or local.

title: Sixty-four lower-case hexadecimal digits
statement: A content digest MUST be a SHA-256 digest written as exactly 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits.

title: A known source state
statement: The source state of a build identity MUST be one of unknown, clean or modified.

title: An unknown source is unknown throughout
statement: When the VCS or the revision of a build identity is unknown, its VCS, revision and source state MUST all be unknown.

title: A full commit ID
statement: A source revision MUST be a full commit ID of 40 lower-case hexadecimal digits.

title: An SSH or GPG signature
statement: A fill signature's key type MUST be ssh or gpg, and its signature MUST be in the armored form that ssh-keygen -Y sign or gpg --detach-sign --armor writes.

title: One of four standings
statement: A qualification standing MUST be exactly one of qualified, stale, unsigned or untested.

title: Written as component.slot
statement: A slot reference MUST be written as the component name, a period and the slot name, each non-empty.

title: One of three kinds
statement: A quality evidence kind MUST be exactly one of security review, benchmark or design review.

title: An official release by digest
statement: A Go SDK pin MUST name an official Go release and the digest of that release's contents, and a build MUST refuse an SDK whose contents differ.

title: SPDX or CycloneDX
statement: An SBOM format MUST be exactly one of SPDX or CycloneDX, each in its JSON form.

title: Keyless workflow or Chains key
statement: A signer identity MUST be either a keyless identity that names an OIDC issuer and a workflow subject with the exact reference the workflow ran at, or a Tekton Chains signer named by the digest of its public key, and never both.

title: GitHub Actions or Konflux
statement: A CI provider MUST be exactly one of github-actions or konflux.

title: A commit or a digest, never a tag
statement: A pinned pipeline reference MUST pin by a full 40-character commit SHA or a sha256 OCI digest, and MUST NOT use a tag, a branch or a short SHA.

title: One of the known kinds
statement: A requirement kind MUST be exactly one of secret, configuration, database, topic, identity issuer, ingress, egress, cluster permission or pod security.

title: Passed, failed or skipped
statement: A test result MUST be exactly one of passed, failed or skipped, and only passed counts as a pass.

title: Each count is at most the total
statement: Designed, built and proved MUST each be between zero and the total, and a share is the count over the total, with an empty spec counted as 100%.

title: The subject is a full commit
statement: An attestation reference MUST name its subject by a full 40-character commit ID, never a tag, a branch or a short ID.

title: Change or release
statement: A gate kind MUST be exactly one of change or release.

title: A tagged version by hash
statement: A runtime pin MUST name the module path, a tagged version and the go.sum hash of that version, never a branch, a pseudo-version or a replace directive.
